scope: Exact controls from literal original moduli/residues. Finite exact controls do not prove forest or unicyclic noncoverage in general.
probability_convention: Every DP count uses the full original prime-power coordinates and unconditioned original Haar; no-prime S and star costs are separately named.

large_scalar_separation.full_original_CRT_enumeration: Not performed: the exact tree DP and independent closed formula agree.

exact_DP_summary.leaf_extension_counts: Zero at 0; one at every other original q-word.

random_forest_controls.scope: Arbitrary residues, distinct odd labels, forests; no CD or divisor-closure filter.

exact_unicyclic_constants.scope: Exact rational arithmetic for constants in the supplied ordinary proof; the infinite-series comparison still uses that proof.

fixed_original_controls.name: triangle_with_original_three_prime_labels
fixed_original_controls.original_Haar_extension_formula: sum_(legal core tuple x) product_(p in core) subtree_extension_count_p(x_p) / original_period
fixed_original_controls.law_distinction: The 1/20 bound is for the uniform independent product of actual V_p; full original Haar uses the recorded nonconstant extension weights.
